question_text: A 34-year-old woman admitted for a polyuria and polydipsia study. In the first 24 hours of admission, a diuresis of 8.2 liters was observed and an analytical sample was obtained showing a glycemia of 96 mg / dL, natremia of 148 mEq / L and plasma osmolality of 309 mOsm / kg with urinary osmolality of 89 mOsm / kg. What diagnostic test should be done next?
